description:
This position is listed on behalf of a partner company, which manages all applications and next steps. Our partner is looking for a Hardware Engineering Expert - AI Training & Evaluation based in the United States. 

 We are seeking experienced hardware engineering professionals to contribute to an advanced AI training and evaluation project focused on real-world engineering challenges. In this role, you will leverage your technical expertise to design complex engineering problems, develop rigorous solutions, and evaluate AI-generated technical outputs. You will work across hardware development, systems integration, simulation, testing, and validation, applying first-principles engineering knowledge to practical industrial scenarios. Your contributions will help improve the accuracy, reliability, and problem-solving capabilities of advanced AI systems. This opportunity is ideal for professionals who have successfully owned and delivered significant engineering projects and enjoy tackling demanding technical challenges. The engagement is fully remote, with flexible working hours and an independent contractor arrangement.



Accountabilities:
 

 Create technically rigorous, self-contained hardware engineering problems based on realistic industrial, product development, and research scenarios.

 Develop detailed reference solutions supported by engineering calculations, simulations, programming scripts, experimental analysis, and other appropriate technical methods.

 Design and evaluate engineering approaches that address practical hardware challenges, system requirements, design constraints, and performance expectations.

 Use relevant engineering software and computational tools to investigate technical problems, analyze assumptions, and validate results.

 Apply programming languages and engineering platforms such as Python, MATLAB, Simulink, SPICE, Julia, C/C++, and test automation tools where relevant.

 Assess proposed engineering solutions for technical correctness, reliability, reproducibility, and real-world feasibility.

 Identify incorrect assumptions, design limitations, calculation errors, and gaps in engineering validation or verification.

 Integrate coding agents and AI-assisted engineering tools into technical analysis, problem-solving, and solution development workflows.

 Ensure that all submitted problems, analyses, and reference solutions meet high standards of engineering accuracy, clarity, and technical rigor.


 Requirements:


 Bachelor's, Master's, or PhD degree in Electrical Engineering, Mechanical Engineering, Mechatronics, Aerospace Engineering, Systems Engineering, Applied Physics, or a closely related technical discipline.

 Significant professional or research experience in hardware engineering, product development, systems integration, testing, validation, reliability engineering, or failure analysis.

 Demonstrated ownership and delivery of substantial engineering projects, such as developing a hardware product or subsystem that successfully reached production, validating computational models against physical test data, designing and implementing hardware testing or verification systems, or diagnosing and resolving complex hardware failures.

 Strong understanding of engineering fundamentals, quantitative analysis, and practical hardware design and performance constraints.

 Proficiency in relevant engineering software, programming languages, simulation environments, computational tools, or test automation platforms.

 Mandatory hands-on experience using coding agents or AI-assisted development tools in engineering or technical workflows.

 Ability to translate complex engineering challenges into structured, technically sound solutions that can be independently reproduced, tested, and verified.

 Excellent analytical and problem-solving abilities, combined with strong attention to detail and technical documentation skills.

 Ability to work independently, exercise sound technical judgment, and communicate engineering concepts and findings clearly.


 Benefits:


 Competitive compensation: $60–$120 per hour, depending on expertise and successful task completion.

 Flexible workload: Approximately 15 hours per week, with the freedom to organize your working schedule.

 Fully remote opportunity: Work remotely from anywhere within the eligible location.

 Independent contractor arrangement: Flexible professional engagement without a traditional full-time employment commitment.

 Advanced technical exposure: Contribute to cutting-edge AI training and evaluation projects involving complex hardware engineering challenges.

 Meaningful impact: Help improve the technical reasoning, engineering accuracy, and problem-solving capabilities of advanced AI systems.

 Output-based compensation: Payment is provided for each task successfully completed in accordance with the defined project specifications. Task duration may vary depending on complexity, individual expertise, and working methodology. Minimum submission requirements apply.

 Accelerated hiring process: Positions are typically filled within 48 hours, making this an opportunity for candidates seeking a quick start.

 Prompt onboarding: Successful applicants are expected to begin their first task within 24–48 hours after completing onboarding.

 Immediate availability: Candidates should be ready to start promptly following selection.
